payload.rebuttal: argued: I reproduced this exact wrong version: emit made a required keyword instead of optional with a None default. CONTEXT.md's wrong-version vocabulary only asks whether the witness survives (passes) or not; it does not require the failure to be an AssertionError rather than any other exception a test runner reports as failed.
